architecture_finding.effect_on_the_pilot: the first incomplete, held or unrecognized order a resident writes after the first reassessment ends the development encounter (safely, fail-closed, with the operational message): the primary question of FD-PILOT-07 (sequential decisions with coherent consequences) cannot be asked of real residents, whose incomplete orders are common
halting_examples: Put the patient in the Trendelenburg position.
architecture_finding.reproduced_on: the published base 352d5fe without the pilot, and with it (test_gi_pilot_page.py::test_p16)
architecture_finding.rule: after the first committed minute, a turn that does not move the clock is 'quiet' only if every action of it is structural (reassessment, consultation, venous access); any other turn re-commits the same minute and the certified authority refuses it with MINUTE_ALREADY_COMMITTED, which halts the development authority permanently (a deliberate rule of P3-28: 'a plan, a held order, a clarification may not commit the same minute a second time')
architecture_finding.what_the_pilot_does: it neither bypasses nor changes the authority; it declares the rule in the launcher, ends the encounter with the operational message and pins it by test
architecture_finding.what_would_change_it: a change of the certified authority's zero-minute-turn semantics (for example, a turn in which nothing is carried out and the clock does not move does not re-commit the minute), which is an authority change and needs a faculty decision, a successor of the authority's certification and its own review
architecture_finding.why_the_ten_reviewed_paths_did_not_meet_: every turn of the ten paths moves the clock, and the development runner of the previous cycle does not call the authority on such a turn

statement: GI_MANAGEMENT_TRACE_V1 is ratified for controlled development pilot preparation (reported human review: ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITATION 10). A development pilot of one GI case, off by default and fail-closed outside the published development configuration, runs the live development pressure authority with the manual norepinephrine control exactly as published under GI_NOREPINEPHRINE_DEVELOPMENT_AUTHORITY_GRANT_V1; it creates no account attempt and reaches no score; it bounds definitive haemostasis before it happens; it labels or withholds the earlier model's mental status; it shows a management trace without internals and with the participant's reasoning only as expressed; and it gives faculty observe, stop, inspect, flag, mark-unusable and replay-review controls over separate, pseudonymous, hash-chained logs. The real pilot was NOT started.

why_not_the_others.A: after the first committed minute the certified authority halts the encounter permanently on a non-structural zero-minute turn (MINUTE_ALREADY_COMMITTED), which common incomplete orders produce; the primary question of FD-PILOT-07 cannot be asked of real residents, and starting the real pilot is not granted
why_not_the_others.B: the source-control boundary is bounded in the pilot: a request for definitive control (47 phrasings) is recorded and not carried out, and an engine source-control event also ends the encounter at the boundary; H1 stays open on the ordinary live page, but it does not block the pilot
why_not_the_others.C: the pressure shown is the live authority's committed minute; every other value is labelled by its source, the earlier model's mental status is labelled or withheld after norepinephrine on every surface (including Spanish and the examination text), and no internal variable is shown
why_not_the_others.D: the participant trace has one provenance per value, the reasoning only as expressed, replay MATCH, and nine safety attacks pinned by test; no internal token reaches it
why_not_the_others.E: faculty observe, stop, inspect, flag, mark unusable and replay-review; logs are pseudonymous, separate and hash-chained; roles are decided on the server; the limits (no signature, an enumerable pseudonym) are declared, not hidden
